en.before: The Qrent platform offers more precise data support to give your application a clearer direction:
en.after: QRent helps compare listings within its existing school-area scope. Its AI scores describe properties and do not predict application approval.

en.before:
| Feature module | Purpose | When to use it |
| --- | --- | --- |
| AI listing scores | Automatically assess value for money and the level of competition | Decide whether a property is worth applying for |

en.after: - Compare actual listings, weekly rents and commutes in QRent; confirm application requirements with the agent.

en.before: when popular properties often receive over a hundred applications within 24 hours.
en.after: Popular listings may have short application windows; promptly check the advertisement and agent requirements.

en.after: 1. **Confirm the window early**: Submit complete documents in time for the agent’s process, without treating a fixed 24-hour window as an approval guarantee.

en.after: - A brief, truthful application letter can explain your circumstances; follow the actual checklist on whether one is needed;

excerpts.zh: 按实际申请方要求准备身份、资金和居住证明，整理真实材料、申请信与备选房源，不把房源评分当作获批概率。

zh.before: 根据 Qrent 平台与澳洲主要中介（Ray White、LJ Hooker、PRD、Belle Property）合作数据统计，
zh.after: 审核时间取决于中介与房东的流程、申请数量和材料完整性。

zh.before: 多数租房申请会在 **2–5 个工作日** 内得到反馈。
zh.after: 申请可能在数日内收到回复，也可能更久。下表用于理解影响进度的因素，不是平均值或回复承诺。

zh.before:
| 情况 | 平均回复时间 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 普通房源 | 2–3 个工作日 | 房东直接审核，进度较快 |
| 高竞争房源（多人申请） | 3–5 个工作日 | 中介需统一整理材料后提交房东 |
| 学生公寓或新楼盘 | 5–7 个工作日 | 通常由总部集中审核，流程更慢 |
zh.after:
| 情况 | 可能影响进度的因素 | 建议确认 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 普通房源 | 房东与中介的审核安排 | 预计回复日和缺少材料 |
| 多人申请 | 材料整理与房东选择 | 是否仍受理申请 |
| 学生公寓或新楼盘 | 运营方审核流程 | 官方平台状态和联系人 |

en.before: According to statistics from cooperation data between the Qrent platform and major Australian agencies (Ray White, LJ Hooker, PRD and Belle Property),
en.after: Review timing depends on the agent and landlord’s process, application volume and document completeness.

en.before: most rental applications receive feedback within **2–5 business days**.
en.after: A response may take several days or longer. The table explains factors affecting timing, not measured averages or a response guarantee.

en.before:
| Situation | Average Response Time | Explanation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Standard property | 2–3 business days | The landlord reviews it directly, so progress is faster |
| Highly competitive property (multiple applicants) | 3–5 business days | The agent needs to collate the documents before submitting them to the landlord |
| Student accommodation or a new development | 5–7 business days | Applications are usually reviewed centrally by head office, making the process slower |
en.after:
| Situation | Factors affecting timing | Confirm |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Standard listing | Agent and landlord review arrangements | Expected reply date and missing documents |
| Multiple applicants | Document processing and the landlord’s decision | Whether applications remain open |
| Student housing or new development | Provider review process | Official application status and contact |

en.before: > If a property has a high number of views on Qrent or Domain, the agent needs to screen the documents before compiling recommendations.
en.after: > Multiple applications may take longer to process. QRent does not provide verified applicant counts or competition labels.

en.after: Check application status with the agent or the agent’s application platform. QRent does not automatically track Under Review / Shortlisted / Declined decisions.

en.before: Choose an area or property type with less competition (Qrent marks “low-competition properties”)
en.after: Broaden options within your budget, housing needs and commute; ask the agent whether applications remain open

en.before: Use the “AI property scoring + area competition analysis” module
en.after: Use existing property scores, budget and commute filters to build a shortlist,

en.before: to predict a property's popularity before applying and choose options that are easier to get approved for.

en.before: - Qrent tools can help track application status and identify properties with a higher chance of approval.
en.after: - QRent favourites help organise alternatives; confirm application progress with the agent.

en.before: > If you want to move in in December (month 12), but the landlord wants to hand over the property in November (month 11), the system will automatically delay processing.
en.after: > A start date that does not fit your plans may affect the decision. Ask the agent rather than assuming a system automatically delays processing.

en.before: Australia does not have a “rental blacklist” or systematic restrictions,
en.after: Regulated tenancy databases exist in Australia; it is incorrect to say there are no blacklists. NSW has rules on eligibility, notice and corrections; see [NSW tenancy databases](https://www.nsw.gov.au/housing-and-construction/rules/tenancy-databases).

en.before: - Results are generally available within 2–5 business days; student accommodation or new developments may take longer;
en.after: - Response times vary with the agent, landlord, documents and holidays; ask the actual provider for its expected timing;

en.before: - You can apply for other properties immediately after a rejection, and it will not affect your credit;

en.before: If you are in China and cannot attend an inspection yourself, you can contact Qrent (through the official website or Xiaohongshu account) for help with a representative inspection. Staff will help verify the listing, record a video, note key property conditions and provide a report.
en.after: Ask a trusted friend or independently checked provider to inspect, confirming the agent’s permission and authorisation requirements first. QRent does not currently offer an active inspection-booking or fulfilment service.

en.before: On mainstream Australian platforms (such as Realestate and Domain), **the vast majority of listings genuinely exist**, because these platforms only allow registered agencies to publish information, and those agencies must hold a state government licence.
en.after: Realestate and Domain help locate properties, but appearing on a platform does not guarantee authenticity, the right to let, or current availability. Independently check the address, advertiser, authority and agreement.

en.before: **Compare Information Across Multiple Platforms**—If a property appears only on social media, it is very likely to be unsafe.
en.after: **Compare Multiple Sources**—A social-only advertisement needs checking; the channel alone cannot establish authenticity.

en.before: **Beware of Low-Price Traps**—A listing in central Sydney priced below 350AUD/week is most likely not genuine.
en.after: **Check Why a Price Is Low**—Distinguish a bed, room and whole property, the billing period and included bills. There is no universal price threshold for authenticity.

en.before: **Refuse Transfers to Personal Accounts**—Agencies usually require the Bond to be paid through a company account or a property trust account.
en.after: **Independently Verify Payment Instructions**—Confirm the recipient and purpose. NSW RBO, other state bond authorities and legitimate private landlords may use different processes; an account name alone is not proof.

en.before: All fees (including the Bond and Holding Deposit) should be paid only after signing a formal rental agreement.
en.after: Do not pay an unverified recipient. A lawful NSW holding fee may be requested after application approval and before signing, capped at one week’s rent. Bonds and advance rent have separate rules. Confirm the purpose and retain a receipt; see [NSW starting costs](https://www.nsw.gov.au/housing-and-construction/rules/costs-at-start-of-a-residential-tenancy).

en.before: Give priority to verified platforms such as Realestate, Domain and Qrent, and avoid transactions through private messages.
en.after: Realestate, Domain and QRent can provide leads; independently verify each property’s right to let, terms and payment recipient.

en.before: **Understand Market Conditions in Advance**: Average rents in central Sydney are 450–550AUD/week, and competition for properties around schools is intense.
en.after: **Compare Current Advertisements**: Compare like-for-like areas, housing types and whole-property or per-person prices. Old figures in this article are not current Sydney averages.

en.before: **Budget Sensibly**: In addition to rent, each person needs to pay an average of about 30AUD/week for water, electricity and Internet (Bills). If the property is unfurnished, the initial furniture outlay is around 2000AUD.
en.after: **Budget Sensibly**: Use actual bills, inclusions and furnishing needs. The source’s 30AUD/week bills and 2000AUD furniture figures are historical examples, not current or universal budgets.

zh.before: ## 三、为什么租房申请一定要写 Cover Letter？
zh.after: ## 三、什么时候需要 Cover Letter？

zh.before: 在澳洲租房流程中，**Cover Letter（租房自荐信）并非形式性材料**。
zh.after: Cover Letter 可以帮助解释情况，但并非所有平台或中介都要求；以实际申请清单为准。

zh.before: 建议长度控制在 **100–150 字**，语言自然即可。
zh.after: 篇幅按申请栏目的限制，用简短、真实的语言说明即可；没有统一字数要求。

zh.before: 需要填写**过去两年的居住地址**。
zh.after: 按实际申请表要求填写真实居住历史；所需年限可能不同。

zh.before: - 房东联系方式可填写父母信息，并由自己完成调查表
zh.after: - 如实说明曾与父母同住，先问中介接受什么证明；推荐人调查应由真实证明人独立完成，不冒充房东或替自己填写

en.before: ## III. Why Must You Write a Cover Letter for a Rental Application?
en.after: ## III. When Is a Cover Letter Needed?

en.before: In the Australian rental process, **a Cover Letter (a rental introduction letter) is not merely a formality**.
en.after: A cover letter can explain your circumstances, but not every platform or agent requires one. Follow the actual application checklist.

en.before: The recommended length is **100–150 characters**, using natural language.
en.after: Use a short, truthful explanation within the application field’s limit; there is no universal word or character count.

en.before: You need to enter **your residential addresses for the past two years**.
en.after: Provide truthful residential history for the period requested by the actual form; requirements vary.

en.before: - For the landlord's contact details, you can enter your parents' information and complete the questionnaire yourself
en.after: - Explain truthfully that you lived with family and ask what evidence is accepted. A genuine referee should complete their own reference; do not pose as a landlord or write your own reference
